card.name: Linking words inside lists and compound phrases
card.fires_on: Commas, 'and', closing parentheses, or a repeated noun like 'health' or 'energy' that sit inside a list or a pair of topic terms in health, energy or policy text, just before the next item.

modes.label: List separators
modes.description: A comma, 'and' or ')' joining items in a list of topics or conditions.
modes.example: communications<<,>> transportation, military and transnational issues.

modes.label: Repeated noun before a compound
modes.description: A noun such as health or energy that starts a compound term, right after a list item.
modes.example: advanced electricity technologies,<< energy>>-related environmental protection

modes.label: Joining names of fields
modes.description: 'and' linking two parts of an organisation or topic title.
modes.example: Noncommunicable Diseases<< and>> Mental Health Dr Oleg Chestnov.

card.plain: It fires on the small joining words and commas in lists of health or policy topics, where another item comes next.
